the series, spells of rain and thunderstorms have been forecast for all three ODIs in 
Chattogram. Odd scheduling, really, right in the monsoon season. The only other time 
international cricket was played in Chattogram in July was eight years ago when 
Bangladesh played a rain-interrupted ODI and Test against South Africa. 
Sean: "Dont think we are getting any cricket soon." Yup, go get your coffees and snacks. 
It could be a bit of a wait before the rain subsides.

quick bowlers.

There has been some inconsistent bounce, but other than that, not a lot more to trouble
